questions.question: (implied) Which parked agent must I nudge to continue -- quota reset, laptop closed, crash?
questions.paraphrase: 'continue' / 'go' / 'limit resets in 5 min' typed at an agent that stopped and waited for him.

questions.question: Where are we on this effort -- how is it going?
questions.paraphrase: Where are we at with the thing you are working on, how is it going?

questions.question: Is it done, merged, deployed and verified live? Can I close the thread?
questions.paraphrase: Is everything merged and shipped, is it live, can we close this?

questions.question: Where is my Claude quota (5 h / 7 d) and when does it reset?
questions.paraphrase: What is my Claude usage, when does the limit reset, can we keep spending tokens?

questions.question: Is everything healthy -- is anything broken right now?
questions.paraphrase: Are all systems healthy, is it all good, why so many alerts at once?
questions.push_note: Kuma, Docker, watchdog, 24 h warnings, warden counts

questions.question: Why does X not work / fail / show the wrong thing?
questions.paraphrase: Why is this not working, why does the page still show the old thing?

questions.question: (implied) Which approvals am I still giving that the agent could decide itself?
questions.paraphrase: You can approve and merge that yourself -- permission handed over, case by case.

questions.question: What happened while I was away (overnight, vacation, laptop closed)?
questions.paraphrase: I am back / good morning -- what got built or changed since I left?
questions.push_note: per-project changelog lines, 24 h warnings; no per-agent record

questions.question: Which herdr tabs / agents are finished and can be closed? Why are so many open?
questions.paraphrase: Why are there still so many tabs open; which are needed; close the finished ones.

questions.question: Is that agent still running, stuck, or done -- does it need something?
questions.paraphrase: Are you still going? Why are you stuck? Is it done, what does it say, does it need anything?

questions.question: Is a connection or credential broken -- do I need to log in / unlock something?
questions.paraphrase: Why does it say unauthorized; are the agents losing connection; do I need to re-auth; the keychain prompt again.

questions.question: Is a host low on disk / CPU / memory -- what is eating it?
questions.paraphrase: The disk is nearly full, CPU is at 100% all the time -- is it us?
questions.push_note: Dev Host heartbeat warnings; no disk or CPU series

questions.question: How are all my agents / tabs / waves doing, across projects and hosts?
questions.paraphrase: Show me every running agent and wave: working, idle, done, stuck -- on the mini and on the MacBook.
questions.push_note: agent overview section (unavailable on 2026-10-22); counts, not per agent

questions.question: What does it cost -- is cost / usage tracking wired and right?
questions.paraphrase: What does this cost, which model is cheaper, is usage tracking wired end to end?

questions.question: Are the docs / AGENTS.md / skills current and consistent?
questions.paraphrase: Is the documentation up to date everywhere, not stale or confusing?

questions.question: Where do I see the report / PR / dashboard / result?
questions.paraphrase: Where can I look at it -- I do not see a link, a PR, or a verdict; reports land in random folders.

questions.question: What is still pending / missing / open in the plan?
questions.paraphrase: How much of the plan is still open, what did you achieve, what is left?

questions.question: What is waiting for me? Which agent or item needs my input?
questions.paraphrase: What needs me right now, and what happens if I ignore it?
questions.push_note: warden needs_decision count and items that ask a question

questions.question: Did the automatic recovery / self-healing work -- or did I have to intervene?
questions.paraphrase: Was the recovery optimal; why did the watchdog not recover it; I had to restart and reconnect manually.

questions.question: Is X wired end to end -- observability, cost tracking, Hermes access?
questions.paraphrase: Is monitoring/cost/usage wired up everywhere; are all gateways reachable from Hermes?

questions.question: Which version runs where -- is the latest code on stage and prod?
questions.paraphrase: Is the most recent code deployed to both stage and prod?

questions.question: Are my machines / tools / dependencies up to date -- what still needs an update or restart?
questions.paraphrase: Is the herdr setup on the mini and here up to date; ready for all the restarts; do the macOS update.

questions.question: Which model / tool / version is configured -- do we have access to the new one?
questions.paraphrase: Do we already have the new model, which model does X use, is that integration available?

questions.question: What did warden / the loop handle alone -- why did this reach me?
questions.paraphrase: Should this not have gone through automatically; are the policies too strict; why is the agent so cautious?

questions.question: Is the data / report / page fresh -- how old is it?
questions.paraphrase: How old is this data, is the report current?

questions.question: Did the nightly / scheduled / auto-update job run, and did it succeed?
questions.paraphrase: Did last night's run happen, what did the auto-update do, check the log tomorrow morning.

questions.question: Why does this keep coming back -- is the recurring issue resolved?
questions.paraphrase: Why does this alert/issue keep happening; is it resolved or do I have to help manually?
